verdict.rationale: Community reports say the pricing page advertises a free individual plan with 'generous rate limits' and that access is tied to Google accounts. However, one user hit a quota error within minutes, and another says some accounts cannot use even the free tier without an 'Antigravity entitlement'. No first-party doc in the pack describes personal-account sign-in or confirms that no API key is needed. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of personal Google account sign-in, explicit confirmation that no API key is required, documented free-tier quota details.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: On the pricing page it says free individual plan with 'generous rate limits'.
don't buy Google AI subscription before you confirm you have 'Antigravity entitlement'
